title: Restriction after padding auxiliary signs
statement: Let $a\leq K$, let $x$ be a sign assignment on $r$ original coordinates, and let $y$ be a sign assignment on $a$ auxiliary coordinates. Extend $x$ by the auxiliary assignment obtained by appending $K-a$ copies of $−1$, then restrict to the first $r+a$ coordinates. The result is exactly the extension of $x$ by $y$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers a and K with a ≤ K
A sign assignment on r original coordinates
A sign assignment on a auxiliary coordinates
